svg.aria-label: The kernel re-checks its own memory before trusting it
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The kernel re-checks its own memory before trusting it
svg.desc: Of the memories the kernel recalled, a single stacked bar split into re-verified-still-true, could-not-re-verify, and gone-stale, with a flow from one source node.
svg.text: It re-checks its own memory before trusting it
75 memories recalled — how many were still TRUE on re-check
1 STALE — the note was wrong now
Only 20 of 75 recalled memories re-verified as still true; 54 were unverifiable, 1 had gone stale.
FRESH = the memory's claims re-check against git + the working tree now.
